page.overview:
Who is Jiraiya?

Jiraiya is one of the Legendary Sannin who trains Naruto Uzumaki, investigates the Akatsuki, and writes of the Child of Prophecy.

Also known as: Pervy Sage, Jiraiya the Toad Sage.
